verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers privacy tooling (Privacy Portal, consent management, GDPR/HIPAA/CCPA compliance) and generic data storage destinations (S3, GCS, warehouses), but nothing describes letting a customer choose a specific data region or residency location for where Segment stores or processes their data. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection docs, EU/US workspace hosting options, and any residency configuration UI or API evidence.
